faq.title: Your questions,
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about how Zentrix works.

q1.question: Will I lose my WhatsApp number?
q1.answer: No. The number stays on your phone, and your team starts replying through Zentrix too, on that same number.

q2.question: Can several agents use the same number?
q2.answer: Yes. Each person logs in with their own account and works from the same shared inbox, with queues and handoffs between agents.

q3.question: Does Zentrix handle Instagram and Facebook?
q3.answer: Yes, from the Pro plan up. Direct, Messenger, and comments land in the same inbox as WhatsApp.

q4.question: Does the AI reply with voice?
q4.answer: Yes, on the Enterprise plan. The AI can reply with a voice note, always or only when the customer sends one.

q5.question: Can the AI book meetings on my calendar?
q5.answer: Yes. Connected to Google Calendar, the AI checks your availability and books straight from the conversation.

q6.question: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q6.answer: No. The free trial starts with no card, and you can cancel anytime.

q7.question: How much does it cost?
q7.answer: Starting at Kz 35,000 per month on Basic. Pro (Kz 75,000) adds multi-agent inbox and campaigns; Enterprise (Kz 150,000) includes AI support with voice and full automations.

q8.question: Does it work with my online store?
q8.answer: Yes. We connect with the main e-commerce platforms, and any other system can integrate through webhooks.

q9.question: How does cart recovery work?
q9.answer: As soon as a customer abandons checkout, an automated flow sends reminders with a link back to finish the purchase.

q10.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q10.answer: Yes, no lock-in. Cancel straight from the dashboard, whenever you want.

q11.question: Can I tell which sales came from WhatsApp?
q11.answer: Yes. Every link is tracked, and each sale is attributed to a click, a read message, or a coupon.

q12.question: Is there support in Portuguese?
q12.answer: Yes, the whole platform and support are available in Portuguese, alongside English and Spanish.
